scope: Source-only JSPI prerequisite audit; no compiler/build/browser/profile/process-control action performed by this audit.
decision: Existing-object link-only JSPI is blocked pending actual SDK exception/callback proof; parent selected exactly one separate O1 Asyncify candidate while preserving the original.

hits.text: void ( *previous_handler )( int sig ) = std::signal( sig, signal_handler );

lexicalInventory.interpretation: Lexical matches include preprocessor-excluded branches and one variable named signal; not a complete resolved call graph. No explicit game SDL_AddEventWatch/SetEventFilter, Emscripten HTML5/main-loop registration, KEEPALIVE, or cataclysm_is_menu match in these 438 source units. Headers/macros and SDK/library internal callers need separate interpretation.

moduleMetadata.stage: Original pre-terminal Asyncify=1 optimizer input, not final JSPI exports; read section metadata only, no execution or validation.

entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Default promising export; callMain awaits its result.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: Proven source sites: mount_idbfs; redraw_invalidated sleep; SDL_Delay.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Successful main wrapping alone does not establish compatibility of nested ordinary JS invoke frames.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: 162 distinct env.invoke_* imports in measured pre-optimizer module
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Imports default to Suspending but make_invoke remains ordinary synchronous JS; no async/await handling.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: Any indirect target that reaches the UI sleep/SDL delay can yield.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Ordinary JS invoke frame blocks suspension; main-only promising wrappers do not remove it. Void invokes also discard Promise results; synchronous catch does not translate later rejected Promise into setThrew.

entryCallerMatrix.callee: Raw wasm table entry or dynCall_*
entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: ASYNCIFY=1 forces DYNCALLS; measured exports retained separately.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Mode 2 does not force legacy DYNCALLS. getWasmTableEntry wraps only table functions whose raw identity is already an async export; dynCall promising defaults false.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: Not all indirect targets are exported or marked asynchronous.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Not automatic whole-table compatibility. Blanket export wrapping changes synchronous scalar/void result and exception semantics.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Native callback via default makeDynCall; keyboard target defaults window.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: No explicit promising callback flag, no await; synchronous EM_BOOL controls preventDefault.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No direct sleep in reviewed callback bodies.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Native callbacks run while main is suspended; event queue/controller watcher and shared-state safety still require game validation. Async callback conversion would break Boolean result semantics.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Default synchronous makeDynCall → callbacks registered by SDL.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: No async callback flag/await; Boolean event handlers remain synchronous.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No direct sleep in reviewed entry callback bodies.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: SDL_PushEvent synchronously runs event filters/watchers; renderer watcher can call renderer function pointers. Entire transitive graph was not proven non-suspending.

entryCallerMatrix.callee: SDL window callbacks → SDL_SendWindowEvent → SDL internal renderer watcher
entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Synchronous Boolean return/native callback; canvas-resized hook direct makeDynCall.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: No async callback wrapper; source entry bodies update window/event state.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No direct sleep in reviewed entry bodies; rendering transitive calls not fully audited.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Renderer watcher runs graphics callbacks and native state changes while main is paused; proof requires selected renderer call graph and real resize/fullscreen tests.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Registered SDL_AddTimer(50) only after a controller exists.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Default synchronous callback; SDL uses callback Uint32 result to decide reschedule.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: timer_func source queues SDL_GAMEPAD_SCHEDULER, returns interval; no direct sleep.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Actual controller path not run. SDL watchers and reentrant queue state need validation; wrapping to Promise would corrupt interval comparison.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Both registration imports are present in measured module; SDL init installs native callbacks.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Default synchronous makeDynCall(iipp); no async callback flag or await.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No direct sleep in reviewed entry callbacks; allocate/free device state and send native events.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Controller watcher can run synchronously during SDL event push; real connect/disconnect behavior and transitive non-suspension are not tested.

entryCallerMatrix.caller: SDK HTML5 event buffer and callMain/invoke/Embind helpers
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No async import established for these helpers by this audit.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Do not wrap them merely because main is suspended: caller requires pointer/scalar immediately. Allocator/stack/EH helpers mutate state and are not pure; reentrancy safety needs actual tests.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Only explicit EMSCRIPTEN_BINDINGS found across 438 units.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Binding has no async() marker; libembind only requests promising native function when isAsync is true.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No UI/yield in getter body; virtual what() and allocation retained.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Current baseline shell never calls this binding. Null/invalid exception handles and exception lifecycle must be tested before adding a caller.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: sigaction installed in main under non-Windows compile branch; no explicit JS signal delivery in shell. Actual pre-optimizer module imports env.__call_sighandler; no setitimer_js import or _emscripten_timeout export found.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Synchronous callback trampoline; not default promising export.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: SIGINT prompt may yield; canceled exit explicitly calls redraw_invalidated()
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Potential suspending secondary entry; actual browser signal delivery not established. Cannot declare safe by wrapping main only.

entryCallerMatrix.callee: IDBFS callback resolves/rejects Promise → suspended main
entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: CPP is sole mount owner; shell observes syncfs callback.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: EM_ASYNC_JS uses shared Asyncify.handleAsync; mode 2 returns Promise with keepalive.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: Real asynchronous IndexedDB restore and new-profile seeding callback.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Initial restore and seeding errors reject the mounted main call; real startup, rejection and retry behavior remain untested.

entryCallerMatrix.caller: CPP filesystem mutation/write helpers → window.setFsNeedsSync → requestAnimationFrame
entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Pure JS IDBFS callback in inspected target; no explicit native callback or Asyncify state reference.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Does not require promising native export for this inspected completion handler.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: Persist is JS asynchronous; native main can continue meanwhile.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Errors are logged, not surfaced to native control flow. FS changes during pending sync and rapid saves need actual snapshot/resume tests.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: No native save command/helper/lock; wrapper version 1 packages native files.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: JS Promise only; does not explicitly enter C++ gameplay.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: JS sync completion awaits IndexedDB; native game may continue.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Packaging existing files is not a gameplay save checkpoint or deterministic save/load proof; user should save in original engine first. Current helper can race ongoing writes.

entryCallerMatrix.caller: PC/mobile helper and text input → sendKey dispatches DOM keyboard events
entryCallerMatrix.callee: SDL input callbacks; separate Rust WASM bridge for text/input mapping
entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: No Module._main, _malloc/_free or cataclysm_is_menu call in current shell; rapid text sends events synchronously.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Native route is SDK callback path above; Rust bridge has separate state/module.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No direct CPP call from controls, except browser-dispatched native callbacks.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Rapid key ordering/queue saturation, IME/CJK text and mobile controls need actual testing; raw JSPI concurrency does not verify game behavior.

entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: Wasm → ordinary JS callback synchronously before returning to engine.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: Current listener does not invoke potentially suspending native gameplay.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: No native suspension in current listener body.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: Future bridge/menu helper calls from this immediate listener would add JS→Wasm reentry and need the same entry audit.

entryCallerMatrix.caller: CPP exit, SDK main completion, DOM beforeunload
entryCallerMatrix.callee: exitJS/handleException; SDL terminating event; shell dirty-state prompt
entryCallerMatrix.currentEntry: SDK mode 2 awaits main before postRun; shutdown Asyncify.state guard is mode 1 only.
entryCallerMatrix.jspi: No verified mode-2 use of mode-1 state/currData in inspected lifecycle branches.
entryCallerMatrix.suspension: beforeunload must be synchronous; main may still be pending.
entryCallerMatrix.risk: beforeunload cannot await native quit/save. Test normal quit, canceled quit, persistence completion, abort/rejection and no second main entry.

independentBrowserPrerequisite.owner: Separate probe/browser agent, evidence read only by source auditor
independentBrowserPrerequisite.conclusion: Tiny raw Wasm proves installed browser JSPI capability and ordinary-JS-frame SuspendError; does not prove Emscripten -fexceptions engine interoperability.

blockers.evidence: -fexceptions current object ABI plus 162 invoke imports; SDK make_invoke ordinary synchronous JS; mode 2 table identity wrapping covers only declared async exports.
blockers.required: Future tiny installed-SDK -fexceptions C++ test with RAII, try/catch, indirect callable → emscripten_sleep and error propagation. No launch authorized/performed by this audit. fwasm-exceptions alternative would require a compatible recompilation, not simply relinking all existing objects.

blockers.evidence: Synchronous DOM/timer callbacks must preserve Boolean, pointer and Uint32 interval contracts; internal SDL renderer/controller watchers exist.
blockers.required: Resolved transitive callback graph and real input/resize/gamepad/quit tests; no generic ASYNCIFY_IGNORE_INDIRECT or blanket export wrapping.

blockers.evidence: Restore errors can reject main; background persist and export do not serialize gameplay or enforce a save checkpoint.
blockers.required: Real new/existing profile restore, save/refresh/resume, injected IDBFS error and normal/canceled quit scenarios.

nonConclusions: No measured current optimizer pass attribution or confirmed Binaryen bug from this source audit.
No claim that multi-hour CPU-active optimization is normal.
No full-engine JSPI link/runtime, mobile support, deterministic gameplay/save or publication success established.
No assertion that malloc/free are pure, merely expected synchronous helper ABI.
